sections.en: The occurrence of comets in the sign

summary.headline: Comets in Virgo to Sagittarius
summary.text: Astrological omens of comets appearing in Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, and Sagittarius, with predicted effects on crops, weather, disease, rulers, warfare, childbirth, rivers, and political unrest. Directional interpretations mention Fars, Iraq, Khuzestan, Ahvaz, Rome, Egypt, Mosul, the Levant, Babylon, and the kings and sultans of various regions.
